Multi-stage fee: £766 in total, paid as £561 (endorsement) + £205 (visa) on the endorsement route, or £766 at once on the prize route. The validator allows ONE application component, so the expected component is the published total, 766 (no arithmetic needed: the page prints it). 561 or 205 alone is a mismatch.
IHS £1,035 per year x 5 (the visa lasts up to 5 years at a time).
Processing time (user decision, 2026-11-09): FULL RANGE: min = outside-UK decision time (3 weeks), max = inside-UK decision time (8 weeks).
